units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 19:4">Ex. R. s. 19</cite> <he>עשיתי ד׳ שלהם בבני</he> (not <cite ref="D00570"><he>דייקי</he></cite>) I gave them (the Gibeonites) satisfaction (for their wrongs) on My children (<cite ref="II Samuel 21:1">II Sam. XXI, 1</cite> sq.).—

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:7:1">Cant. R. to II, 7</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 32:1">Is. XXXII, 1</cite>) [read:] <he>עד שגובה ד׳ שלו</he> until He collects His debt of justice (punishes Israel for his sins).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> <he>תבע ד׳ דידי</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="D01003"><he>דקיון</he></cite>) plead my cause; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 22">Num. R. s. 22</cite>; Tanḥ. Matt. 3 [read:] <he>אינו אלא ד׳ שלכם מתבקשים</he> it is your cause which is taken up.—Pl. <he>דִּיקִין</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:3:6">Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᵇ</cite> <he>כהדין דירין</he> (corr. acc.) like court proceedings, v. <cite ref="B00923"><he>במגנימין</he></cite>.
